newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 21 to 23 bln Ffr of BTANs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 21 to 23 bln Ffr of BTANs Thursday.

text.p: France is to offer between 21 and 23 billion francs of government bonds (BTANs) at its next scheduled auction on January 16, the Treasury said on Tuesday.
The Treasury will offer the 4.75 percent April 12, 1999, BTAN with a payment date of February 5.
The Treasury said it would also offer the 5.50 percent October 12, 2001, BTAN with a payment date of February 12.
